name: GoHighLevel
body:
> Tool · 2026-05-28

# Summary
GoHighLevel (GHL) is the CRM, form and call-tracking platform behind TAG's client sub-accounts. TAG's GHL is white-labeled: the admin UI is `app.pipelinersusa.com` (same backend as app.gohighlevel.com). Claude reaches it read-only through per-sub-account Private Integration tokens kept in `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\GHL\.env` [redacted, never opened or copied].

# The token SOP (GHL folder)
`SOP-ghl-private-integration-token.md` (plus a `.docx` copy and 3 redacted screenshots) walks Kim through creating one token per sub-account:
1. Pick names: sub-account, `.env` key suffix (SUMMIT, PIPELINERS, ALPHALETE), integration name "Kim Claude Code - <SubAccount>".
2. Keep `.env` out of git (`.gitignore`). The token is treated like a password.
3. Switch to the sub-account; Settings > Private Integrations. If missing, Scott enables it; if the Create button is gone the sub-account is at its cap (about 5), so ask Scott to delete a dead integration.
4. Create with **read-only scopes only**: View Contacts, Conversations, Opportunities, Calendars, Forms, Locations, Custom Fields, Workflows, Tags.
5. Copy the token immediately (shown once), then copy the Location ID from the URL.
6. Test against the LeadConnector API `/locations/{id}` (expect HTTP 200); troubleshooting covers 401, 403, 404, DNS and unloaded env vars.
7. Hygiene: rotate every 90 days, check "Last used" monthly, revoke on offboarding, rotate immediately if leaked.

| Sub-account | Location ID | Token created |

| Summit Plumbing Pros (Mesa, AZ) | V7KqTFAVLIlfd8z0YSud | 2026-05-27 |

Pipeliners was at its integration cap on May 28; Scott deleted one of two unused duplicate "Housecall Pro" integrations to free a slot.

# Key facts from other TAG files
- **Form widgets use different white-label domains** than the admin UI: `link.tagmktg.com` (Summit), `links.pipelinersusa.com` (Pipeliners), `link.alphaletetrenchless.com` (Alphalete). GHL iframe forms broke Google Ads conversion tracking on all three sites in spring 2026 (see [Google Ads Validation Work](lib:brain-google-ads-validation-work)).
- **Pipeliners lead source labeling:** Google Ads leads land in the "Lead Source" custom field as "adwordsPaid Searchadwords" or "Paid Search", not "Google Ads". Filter on those values or a non-empty GCLID.
- **Summit DNI:** pool tracking numbers on the Summit site are intentional GHL call tracking. Never disable the DNI snippet.
- **Alphalete:** the GHL number pool (Code Snippet #5) stays off; call tracking there is [WhatConverts](lib:brain-whatconverts).
- Summit's 49-day GHL pull (May 2026) had 19,272 contacts but only 2 with real GCLIDs, so GHL was not where Summit's historical Ads conversions came from.
- The [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker) lead refresh script calls the GHL API read-only; Python requests need a curl-style User-Agent or GHL returns 403.

# Rules
- Read-only. No contact, tag, workflow or form edits by Claude.
- Never print or copy tokens into notes, chats or reports.

# Files
- `SOP-ghl-private-integration-token.md` / `.docx`: the SOP.
- `screenshots/`: 3 redacted UI screenshots (list page, token dialog, location ID in URL).
- `_build_sop_docx.js`, `_fix_xml.py`, `screenshots/_redact.py`: helper scripts (not summarized).
